cancel_invoice.description: Cancel a PayPal invoice that was sent and isn't paid, so the customer can no longer pay it.
cancel_invoice.name: cancel_invoice

parameters.description: The invoice, by the ID Send invoice gave back, such as INV2-Z56S-5LLA-Q52L-CPZ5.
parameters.name: invoice_id

parameters.description: Tell the customer by email that the invoice was cancelled.
parameters.name: notify_recipient

status.description: CANCELLED once PayPal has cancelled it.

capture_order.description: Collect (capture) the payment for an approved PayPal order.
capture_order.name: capture_order

parameters.description: The ID of the order to collect payment for
parameters.name: order_id

returns.description: PayPal capture result object returned by the PayPal API containing payment capture details.

create_order.description: Create a PayPal checkout order ready for buyer approval.
create_order.name: create_order

parameters.description: Order amount
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: Currency code (e.g. USD)
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Order description
parameters.name: description

returns.description: PayPal order object returned by the PayPal API containing order details and approval links.

create_plan.description: Create a recurring billing plan for a PayPal product.
create_plan.name: create_plan

parameters.description: The ID of the PayPal product this plan is for
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: Plan name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: How often to bill, such as DAY, WEEK, MONTH, or YEAR
parameters.name: interval_unit

parameters.description: How many units between each charge. For example, 3 with MONTH bills every 3 months.
parameters.name: interval_count

parameters.description: Billing currency
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Recurring charge amount
parameters.name: amount

returns.description: PayPal billing plan object returned by the PayPal API containing plan configuration details.

create_product.description: Add a product to your PayPal catalog so it can be used in billing plans.
create_product.name: create_product

parameters.description: Product name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Product description
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Product category, for example SOFTWARE
parameters.name: category

returns.description: PayPal product object returned by the PayPal API containing product details.

get_invoice.description: Look up a PayPal invoice: whether it's been paid, how much is still due, and who it went to.
get_invoice.name: get_invoice

parameters.description: The invoice, by the ID Send invoice gave back, such as INV2-Z56S-5LLA-Q52L-CPZ5.
parameters.name: invoice_id

amount_due.description: How much is still to pay, empty when PayPal doesn't say.

currency.description: The currency code, such as USD.

due_date.description: The due date, empty when it's due on receipt.

invoice_number.description: The number printed on the invoice.

invoice_url.description: The page where the customer views and pays it.

recipient_email.description: The email address it was sent to.

status.description: Where the invoice is, such as DRAFT, SENT, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID or CANCELLED.

get_order.description: Look up the current status and details of a PayPal order.
get_order.name: get_order

parameters.description: The ID of the order to look up
parameters.name: order_id

returns.description: PayPal order object returned by the PayPal API with current order state and details.

get_payment.description: Look up a payment PayPal collected: its amount, status, the fee PayPal kept and the order it belongs to.
get_payment.name: get_payment

parameters.description: The payment, by its ID: the transaction ID New payment gives, or a capture's ID from Collect payment for an order, such as 2GG279541U471931P.
parameters.name: capture_id

amount.description: What was paid: value (such as 49.99) and currency_code.

custom_id.description: Your own reference on it, if one was given.

invoice_id.description: Your own invoice number on it, if one was given.

net_amount.description: What you keep after PayPal's fee, such as 47.75.

order_id.description: The order it belongs to, for Get order.

status.description: Where it stands, such as COMPLETED, PENDING, REFUNDED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED or DECLINED.

get_subscription.description: Look up a PayPal subscription: whether it's active, who subscribed, their last payment and when they're billed next.
get_subscription.name: get_subscription

parameters.description: The subscription, by its ID, such as I-BW452GLLEP1G.
parameters.name: subscription_id

last_payment_amount.description: Their last payment, such as 9.99; blank before the first.

next_billing_time.description: When they are billed next; blank once it has ended.

plan_id.description: The billing plan it is on.

status.description: Where it stands: APPROVAL_PENDING, APPROVED, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, CANCELLED or EXPIRED.

refund_capture.description: Issue a partial or full refund for a captured PayPal payment.
refund_capture.name: refund_capture

parameters.description: The ID of the captured payment to refund
parameters.name: capture_id

parameters.description: Amount to refund. Leave blank to refund the full amount.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: Currency code for the refund (e.g. USD). Required when you enter an amount.
parameters.name: currency

returns.description: PayPal refund object returned by the PayPal API containing refund status and details.

send_invoice.description: Email a customer a PayPal invoice for one amount, which they can pay online by PayPal or card. It's due when received unless you give a due date.
send_invoice.name: send_invoice

parameters.description: The email address to send the invoice to.
parameters.name: recipient_email

parameters.description: The line on the invoice, such as 'Website design, May'.
parameters.name: item_name

parameters.description: The amount to bill, such as 49.99.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: Currency code (e.g. USD).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Optional message shown on the invoice.
parameters.name: note

parameters.description: Optional date the invoice is due. Leave blank for due on receipt.
parameters.name: due_date

amount_due.description: How much is still to pay, empty when PayPal doesn't say.

currency.description: The currency code, such as USD.

due_date.description: The due date, empty when it's due on receipt.

invoice_number.description: The number printed on the invoice.

invoice_url.description: The page where the customer views and pays it.

recipient_email.description: The email address it was sent to.

status.description: Where the invoice is, such as DRAFT, SENT, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID or CANCELLED.

description: Accept payments, send invoices, manage catalog products, and automate billing with PayPal.

paypal_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is created in PayPal, whether a draft or sent straight away, by your team, Send invoice or another app.

output.amount_due: What is still owed, such as 49.99.
output.currency: The currency code, such as USD.
output.due_date: When it is due (YYYY-MM-DD), if a date was set.
output.invoice_number: The number printed on the invoice.
output.invoice_url: The page where the customer can see and pay it.
output.recipient_email: The email address it is for.
output.recipient_name: The customer's name or business name, when given.
output.status: Where it is, such as DRAFT, SENT, PAID or CANCELLED.

paypal_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a new payment is received in PayPal.

parameters.description: Only run for payments that are completed, pending, reversed or denied. Leave it on any status to run for every payment.
parameters.name: status
